games.name: Elf Bowling 1 & 2
games.description: The handheld collection, running in a browser emulator. Includes the original bowling game and Elves in Paradise. This is the 2005 GBA edition, separate from the Windows original.
games.launchHint: Click Play Game on the player page. Click inside the game, then press Enter to start. Use Z to confirm and bowl.
games.controls: Enter: Start. Arrow keys: select and aim. Z: A / confirm / bowl. X: B / back. The hosted player's Control Settings button shows its complete mapping.
testedActions: Embedded public page loaded in WebThen
Bowled with Z; elves knocked down
games.verificationLimit: Basic play only; Elves in Paradise, full game completion, saves, mobile controls and other browsers not tested.

games.name: Alien Hominid
games.description: The original web game preserved as a Flash file and played through the archive's Ruffle player. Not the later console release.
games.launchHint: Click the player power button, then follow the game's own title screen.
games.controls: Use the game's instructions. Original controls: arrows to move, A to shoot, S to jump. Click inside the game first so it receives keyboard input.
games.verificationNote: Archive metadata identifies Ruffle SWF playback, but the power-button screen did not reliably launch in WebThen. Interactive playback remains unverified.

games.name: Elf Bowling — Windows original
games.description: The preserved Windows collection requires downloading and running the game outside WebThen. It is not a browser player. The GBA edition above can be played inside WebThen.
games.controls: Windows download required; compatibility and execution are untested.

games.name: Hapland
games.description: Robin Allen’s point-and-click puzzle. Work out how the little people, switches and scenery fit together to open the portal.
games.launchHint: Click inside the game. If Ruffle shows a Play button, click it to start.
games.controls: Use the mouse to click people, switches and objects. Timing and the order of your actions matter. Use the game’s own reset control or WebThen Restart to start again.
games.verificationNote: Basic mouse interaction checked in WebThen on November 19, 2026. Full puzzle completion, audio, mobile and other browsers remain unverified. The creator’s current page includes a modern promotion and is not a verified 2005 webpage capture.
testedActions: Loaded creator-hosted Ruffle game inside WebThen
Toggled built-in help open and closed
Clicked cannon and observed aiming position change
